Convert column to date or datetime format

Source: R/update_columns.R
col_to_date.Rd

`col_to_date` converts column to date or datetime format.

Usage

col_to_date(
  .data,
  date_col,
  date_format = "m/d/Y",
  tz = Sys.timezone(),
  datetime = FALSE
)

Arguments

.data

Dataframe.

date_col

String. Name of date column.

date_format

String. Date format. Uses the same formatting as [lubridate::parse_date_time()]. Default value "m/d/Y".

tz

String. Specifies the timezone used to parse dates. Uses system timezone as default.

datetime

Boolean. If `TRUE`, returns column in datetime format. If `FALSE`, returns column in date format. Default `FALSE`.

Value

Converts column to date or datetime and returns dataframe

See also

[col_to_numeric, col_to_time]
